# ELAPACK

> Custom luxury packaging manufacturer founded in 2018, own factory in Wuxi, Jiangsu, China with three production lines. Designs and produces custom boxes, pouches, bags, and complete packaging sets for jewelry, eyewear, cosmetics, and fragrance brands in Europe and North America. ISO 9001 certified (production and sales of paper and textile packaging products).

Key facts for buyers:

- Minimum order quantity: 200 units per design
- Production lead time: 15–20 days
- Samples: stock samples free (+USD 20 shipping); custom samples USD 25 (+USD 20 shipping)
- Payment: T/T (bank transfer) or PayPal
- Contact: tina@elapack.com | WhatsApp +86 186 2635 2096

## Product collections

- [Custom jewelry boxes](https://elapack.com/custom-jewelry-boxes/): rigid, velvet, leatherette, and wooden jewelry boxes with custom logos and interiors
- [Custom jewelry pouches](https://elapack.com/custom-jewelry-pouches/): velvet, cotton, satin, muslin, linen, and microfiber pouches
- [Jewelry packaging](https://elapack.com/custom-jewelry-packaging/): boxes, pouches, and displays for jewelry brands
- [Eyewear packaging](https://elapack.com/eyewear-packaging/): cases, pouches, and boxes for eyewear brands
- [Custom gift boxes](https://elapack.com/custom-gift-boxes/): magnetic-closure and ribbon-finish luxury gift boxes
- [Cosmetic packaging](https://elapack.com/custom-cosmetic-packaging/): boxes for cosmetics brands
- [Cosmetic pouches](https://elapack.com/custom-cosmetic-pouches/): custom pouches for beauty products
- [Drawstring bags](https://elapack.com/custom-drawstring-bags/): cotton, muslin, and satin drawstring bags
- [Wig packaging](https://elapack.com/custom-wig-packaging/): satin bags and boxes for wigs and hair extensions
- [Ribbons & accessories](https://elapack.com/ribbons-accessories/): satin ribbon closures, logo-printed ribbons, cotton cords, and drawstrings
- [All products](https://elapack.com/products/): 25 custom packaging products across boxes, pouches & bags, and complete sets
